name: aidenbridge_android_smoke
description: Verify that the pinned AidenBridge APK can be opened on the CI Android emulator through the ADB environment bridge.

tasks.description_for_judge: Open the installed Aico App (package com.aidenbridge) from the Android home screen and inspect its visible page.
tasks.prompt: 请打开 Aico App，查看并描述当前页面。

rubric.check: The post-screenshot shows Aico App in the foreground, not the Android launcher, another app, or an app crash dialog.
The answer describes the visible Aico App page accurately without claiming an unverified Phone Bridge connection.
